name: Green Software Practitioner
description: Learn the concepts needed to build, maintain and run greener applications
accessibilitySummary: Course is text-based with infographics and includes quizzes. French language version available.

audience.audienceType: Anyone involved in the process of building, deploying, or managing software, anyone who wants to make their software applications more sustainable and build a career in green software

competencyRequired: No prior knowledge of computing infrastructure required, ideally have at least one year of industry experience building, deploying, or managing software applications.
teaches: The core drivers of carbon emissions for software applications.
The 3 actions one can take to reduce the carbon emissions of your software.
How to measure software emissions using the Greenhouse Gas (GHG) protocol or the Software Carbon Intensity (SCI) specification.
The different types of corporate climate targets so you can align your green software proposals to help meet your organization's public commitments.

about.name: Green Software Practitioner (Basics of Green Computing)
